verdict.rationale: The core product is an MIT-licensed set of skill files. The installer writes them into your own repo as ordinary editable files you own, with no hosted service required to run them (docs-24, docs-2, docs-47, docs-42). A real end-to-end install copied the `tdd` skill into a local `.claude/skills/` directory and it read back cleanly (probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation on self-hosting or mirroring the distribution itself (installs and updates fetch from GitHub or the official plugin marketplaces), and independent corroboration of running a fully forked or offline copy.
